chunks: And indeed, ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb narrated from Burayd al-ʿIjlī, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
That he goes out to one of the miqats, enters ihram from it, and performs ʿUmrah.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the source of the ruling
key_terms.الْمَوَاقِيتِ: the appointed stations of miqat from which ihram is entered
key_terms.فَيُحْرِمُ: he enters into the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What must a person do after invalidating an ʿUmrah according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the one whose ʿUmrah has been invalidated. It states that he must go out to one of the miqats, enter ihram from there, and perform ʿUmrah again.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2947 - Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated from Burayd al-‘Ijli, from Abu Ja'far (as):
"He (a person who invalidates their Umrah) must go out to one of the Miqats, enter Ihram from there, and perform a new Umrah."
